ns2:section.sectionText: Course covers principles of game design, game theory, and current video game technologies related to multiplayer games and virtual worlds. Topics include theory of game design (interaction, play, etc.), story crafting, game engines, graphics, physics simulations, AI simulation, world design, play testing, multi-player interaction models, and user interface design. Students will apply theoretical concepts taught during lectures to a semester-long video game design project of their choosing. Meets with CS 498 GG and MUS 404 C.
